runtimeMapping.normal: Lowest-DEF single Physical arrow; original CAST0 release selection, Attack_Loop (Down front alias), OnAttack .1, original Idle-to-attack begin mixing .167. Original source arrow speed14/lifetime10/maxHit1/unmanaged and no invalid-source stop.
runtimeMapping.s1: Exact selected shared table skill skcom_quickattack[3] with native prefab override skchr_fartth_1. Selected ATK percentage and flat ASPD; one original native arrow, no inherited scatter.
runtimeMapping.s2: Selected flat ASPD. Native specialized trigger plus primary Global description establishes ordinary range OR enemies blocked anywhere, still one lowest-DEF legal victim; normal unblocked victims inside range remain legal.
runtimeMapping.s3: Selected ATK percentage; original one-wide forward infinite range selector. On output, original CheckTargetInRange compares target to explicit BB range_id3-9; only failed membership receives damage_scale. No distance-based or off-line extra attacks. Exact chararts aliases Skill_Begin/Idle/Loop/End map to Skill3 literal clips.
runtimeMapping.talent1: Selected E1/E2/potential ATK percentage after10 seconds without an accepted ordinary incoming damage modifier. Original applied-damage checker, rather than output attacks/block/combat/HP-loss, resets the clock; native toggle creates/removes named ATK child.
runtimeMapping.talent2: E2 selected skill-active taunt-1 and literal ON_OUTPUT_MODIFIER PHYSICAL miss-ignore. Emitted active-skill arrow retains exact source/victim/attackId dodge bypass independently of source retirement; no normal or Arts blanket immunity.

limitations: Native C# selectors, modifier-copy/toggle loaders and mixing FSM dispatch are unrecovered; no recorded-client/frame parity is claimed. Lowest-DEF postFilter9 and S2 blocked-union behavior are additionally supported by primary Global descriptions, while native tie ordering remains bounded.

Native ToggleAbility restoreDelay0 is selected through BB delay10. Accepted damaged events are used for applied damage modifiers, including shielded/zero accepted output; precise native zero/cancel/elemental-gauge/modifier-filter edges are unrecovered. HP-loss bypasses ordinary damage receipt.

Normal mixing is represented by .167 first-entry begin plus .1 loop event, then loop events while a legal target remains. Empty range and mode change reset entry. Exact native idle/combat transition clocks, dynamic retiming, mix interruption and release ordering are unrecovered. Source timeMode0/maxAnimScale-1 uses sampled baseBAT/currentInterval playback.

S3 begin/end source presentation and idle aliases are preserved with a .167 sampled begin attack lock; native skill-modifier/start/escape ordering and mix interruption timing remain unrecovered. Skill duration comes from the selected original table.

S3 output range membership uses target body/tile intersection against the original range_id3-9 at impact, with source tile/facing captured on arrow emission. Native CheckTargetInRange geometric dispatch, edge/large-body membership and modifier-versus-shield order are unrecovered. The conditional DamageScale is passed through the ordinary damage multiplier pipeline.

Native attachPassiveBuffsOnDummy1/ignoreIfOwnerDead0 plus unmanaged projectile/source-invalid0 preserve a born skill arrow passive contract across mode end/withdrawal. The exact native passive-snapshot and late skill-on/skill-off dummy reevaluation semantics are unrecovered; current active-skill selection is retained per emitted arrow.

Original arrow trail/hit Unity effects, muzzle/mount offset, three-dimensional arc/collision and force-reached expiry ordering are not fully reproduced. Exact source mover14/lifetime10/forceReachedWhenTimeup1 and legal target lifetime are retained.
Modules and mode-specific mechanics are not enabled by this regular-stage kit.
